name: external-clink-roster
description: No codereview tool; several CLI clients are present and one eligible client fails. Every eligible non-authoring provider must be attempted exactly once with the verified request contract, with the failure disclosed and no substitution.
prompt: Use `$kk:review-code:isolated` to resume the supplied checkpoint.md and present the review.
trap: The actor dispatches the authoring provider's client, counts two Google clients as two providers, sends a diff-only first request, or retries/replaces the failed client.

assertions.text: The actor loads the isolated workflow and the shared external-review protocol before stating a backend decision.

The roster is exactly claude (Anthropic) and agy (Google): codex is excluded as the authoring provider (OpenAI) and gemini is not a candidate (executable not found; Google is represented by the operator's declared choice of agy).

Each roster client receives exactly one initial request with cli_name set, role `default`, allow_edits false, no continuation_id, the project root as working directory and the complete manifest (criteria, diff, candidate source, intent/context) in absolute_file_paths; no diff-only planning call and no model parameter.
agy's authentication failure is disclosed as a failed attempt with its error; it is not retried, and no substitute client, API model or authoring-provider client is used.
claude's findings are retained with attribution and its returned read trace cited as receipt; the P1 is corroborated by the internal reviewer and Anthropic only, and the verdict is REQUEST_CHANGES.
